fields.statement: QA cycle 1, scratch build of the branch head in a fresh scratch repo: ran the model.md examples (add capabilities reports/export-csv, rhiza link export-csv decided-by csv-streaming, rhiza tree, rhiza describe). The ten kinds and the fifteen link types with their endpoints match internal/check/endpoints.go; a wrong-endpoint link (decision verifies capability) is refused; a reference to reports is stored by ID, someone@example.com is left alone, a doubled at-sign becomes a literal one. One claim is wrong: line 64 says handles are unique among siblings, but `rhiza add capability export-csv` under a different parent, and `rhiza add decision reports`, are both refused with 'handle ... is taken' (handles are unique among all live nodes). go test ./internal/doclinks ok.

QA cycle 1, scratch build in a fresh scratch repo: ran change new (intention and --kind record), change use, --record write, propose, accept --reason --rule, reject, withdraw (writes refused afterwards), change ls/show, land, log, render then check (ok). depends-on between change sets: a loop is refused and land stops naming the draft dependency. carve access-roles --from/--to --with-children moved the node and its child with entries on both sides. reopen took a branch-landed change set back to accepted. All as documented. Small wording mismatch: rhiza log prints 'Carved from X into Y' on both sides rather than 'carved from'/'carved into'.

QA cycle 1, scratch build in a fresh scratch repo: ran every why.md example in order in one change set. apply decision.json, add question, link blocks, source add --raw-sha256, add evidence, link verifies, rhiza why (decisions, sources, change sets shown), rhiza slice and --view as-is (refused for an unlanded node, as stated) all work. But `rhiza question answer csv-delimiter ...` fails as the page sequences it ('not an open question blocking this change set'), even with the question also linked blocks to the change set. It succeeds only for a question that is already landed and blocks a node the current change set touches. accept/reject take --reason and --rule, and the source add raw flags exist.
